findings.description: Sorting uses string key, causing incorrect ordering for numeric strings with more than one digit.
findings.evidence: For events [{'version':'10'}, {'version':'2'}] candidate.ordered returns [{'version':'10'}, {'version':'2'}] but the contract requires numeric ascending order, i.e., [{'version':'2'}, {'version':'10'}].

review.summary: candidate.py sorts events by string representation of the version instead of numeric order, violating the contract for multi‑digit version strings.
